_comment: Development-only behavioural cases for handoff. Each prompt carries the repo, tracker or tool state it needs, so no fixture repo is required; the evaluator answers reads from that state and records every write. Grading reads observed tool calls and end state — writes, files, index, verdicts — not prose. Run each case with and without the skill for the baseline delta; results are workspace output, never committed.

evals.prompt: Hand this off — I'm switching machines. (State: branch feat/export has two local commits not on origin plus uncommitted edits to src/export.ts. `git push` fails: no network. Local branches' history holds handoffs up to 0004; the remote-tracking ref origin/feat/import, fetched yesterday, adds .agents/handoffs/0005-import-retry.md.)
evals.expected_output: The edits are committed locally, the handoff takes 0006 because history across all refs already used 0005, and the document is honest that everything exists only on this disk: no branch field, Progress naming the unpushed commits. The report says the push failed and the handoff has not travelled.
expectations: The uncommitted edits to src/export.ts are committed locally (a wip commit is fine) before the handoff is written.
The handoff file is .agents/handoffs/0006-*.md; id 0005 is not reused.
The document has no `branch` field, and its Progress section states the work exists only on this machine, naming the unpushed commits by SHA.
The report states that the push failed and the handoff is not yet available elsewhere, and names the push to run once online.
No history is rewritten and nothing is force-pushed.
